public.text: Public governance is treated as a defining property, but it is unclear whether components not currently publicly governed are excluded from DPI-H or may become DPI-H once appropriate governance is established.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that DPI-H classification describes the target governance condition. Existing systems may provisionally realise the capability, but should not be treated as conformant DPI-H components until public accountability, access, control, and lifecycle arrangements are established.
